## List connected social media accounts

### How it works

1. Runs when you click Execute Workflow.
2. Lists your connected SocialRobot accounts.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the SocialRobot community node and connect your SocialRobot API credential (API key: socialrobot.io, Scheduler -> API Keys).

### Customization

The list covers every account connected to SocialRobot, ready to feed into other nodes. Run it any time to post, or connect a Schedule Trigger to automate it. Everything runs inside your own n8n workspace, so you can change any step after import. Run it once with a test post to confirm every node behaves as expected before you rely on it. You can duplicate the workflow to try variations without touching the original.

## List accounts

Lists your connected SocialRobot accounts.
